venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Monday 3/2.** Slow start; traffic picked up ~6:30. Snow caused five cancellations, mostly larger parties. Busy until a lull ~9:15, then a few larger walk-in parties and some reservations. Strong comms; pulled bottles from the back bar for neat pours and base spirit suggestions. Kitchen: 15.24% of sales; sold through the new oyster shipment by 8pm; potatoes and Chips/Dip moved well. MOD: Josh.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Monday 3/2.** Intensely chill, slow night as the pleasant weekend dissipated, including zero covers between 7:15 and 8; high share of neighborhood residents; very date-heavy (only 26% of parties over two). Back catalog: Goodnight Moonman. Dante on point. 2 large parties (bookends), 6 solos, 3 $12 cocktails. Comps $152.16. Top sellers: Wax Simulacra, Cielo Asilo, Masari. Door: cold Monday, very slow open lifted by an 8 top walk-in, quiet at 8pm (3 two-tops), city folk emerged at 9pm filling to 2/3, 6 top birthday at 10pm, slowed at 11:30; welcomed Kevin Channel (FO Willie), Emily from Chinato, Robert Haynes (Apologue rep), and a group referred by Close Company Atlanta. No-show: Nicholas Sardella 2 @ 8:00pm (charged).
